context: The party has just stolen a relic from a crypt beneath an abandoned chapel; when the item was taken all the nearby candles sputtered out and sounds of movement now come from another room. Shadowheart is with the group and has already been puzzled by the chapel’s unknown patron, noting clues that this was once a Selûnite site possibly defiled by Sharran forces. Her remark about using the darkness reflects that she’s unusually at ease in shadowy situations — she may be a Shar adherent or possess Sharran artefacts (the player may or may not yet know this). Off-screen, expect whatever was awakened to be approaching, and Shadowheart favors exploiting darkness rather than fleeing.
